name: UDF Extraction via Minimal Direction Field
definition: Extracting an Unoriented Distance Field (UDF) from a DDF by optimizing a field v*: B -> S^2 such that UDF(p) = d(p, v*(p)).
summary: UDF Extraction via Minimal Direction Field converts a Directed Distance Field into an Unoriented Distance Field by optimizing a direction field to point at the closest surface, offering a robust alternative to direct fitting.
